close_reason: Confirmed: #[forbid(unsafe_code)] present at crate root in lib.rs; no change needed
description: lib.rs:19. The crate has no FFI, no raw pointer arithmetic, no platform intrinsics. forbid(unsafe_code) is the right choice: it is stronger than deny (cannot be overridden per-module with allow), and it signals to auditors that no soundness argument is needed. A contributor might suggest removing it to 'allow flexibility later'; the correct response is that flexibility in unsafe usage is not a goal here and introducing any unsafe would require a deliberate change to the crate root.
title: #[forbid(unsafe_code)] at crate root: correct for a library with no unsafe need
